summary: Defines a DHCPv6 mechanism for assigning link-layer (MAC) addresses. It is aimed at settings such as large virtualization deployments, where many devices are created automatically and random assignment could cause address collisions. A server hands out addresses so duplicates are avoided.

eli5.summary: When a huge number of virtual computers are created, each needs a unique hardware name. This lets a central helper hand out names so no two collide.

questions: how to assign mac addresses with dhcpv6
